text: I can derive failures tolerated (N − W, N − R), latency (W-th and R-th fastest replica) and availability with binomial math for any N, R, W.
I can compute Cassandra's QUORUM and LOCAL_QUORUM sizes for a multi-data-centre keyspace and say which cross the WAN.
I can prove R + W > N with the pigeonhole argument and give a timeline where it still returns a non-linearizable result.
I can explain how a sloppy quorum breaks overlap and how hinted handoff restores the data later.
I can describe digest-based read repair and why it never fixes data nobody reads.
I can explain Merkle-tree anti-entropy and why repair must run within gc_grace_seconds to stop deleted rows coming back.
